title: Creative Experiment Planner
purpose: Choose the next learning test before producing another batch of ads.
disclosure: FICTIONAL WORKED EXAMPLE. All products, feedback and constraints here are synthetic. No campaign has run and no performance result is claimed.

sources.label: Fictional product brief
sources.text: A fictional approval tool shows an assigned owner and a timestamped decision trail. No measured turnaround improvement, integrations or compliance certification is supplied.

sources.label: Positive feedback
sources.text: The owner field made it clear who needed to reply.

sources.label: Mixed feedback
sources.text: I could find the owner, but our approvals still waited on legal review.

sources.label: Unresolved buyer question
sources.text: Can an external reviewer open it without creating an account?

sources.label: Production inventory
sources.text: A local demo workspace and a screen recorder are available. External access is unverified. No customer logos or real customer records may be shown.

cards.title: Feature view versus task view
cards.decision: Test whether showing the task makes the next step clearer.

fields.Question: Does a task demonstration help people evaluate an owner and decision trail?
fields.Control: The same product shown with a feature label.
fields.Treatment: Open a synthetic approval record, point to its owner, then reveal the decision trail.
fields.Held constant: Offer, audience, landing page, placement and body copy; schedule remains to be agreed.
fields.Primary metric: Landing-page arrivals / impressions during the same agreed test window.
fields.Guardrail: Completed product-detail interactions / landing-page arrivals. Tracking must be verified.
fields.Review rule: Agree baseline, allocation and sufficient sample before launch; no fixed spend threshold supplied.
fields.Inconclusive outcome: If tracking fails or volume is insufficient, report insufficient evidence, not a winner.

cards.next: Verify event definitions and set the review rule with the campaign owner.

cards.title: Resolve the practical objection first
cards.decision: An ad about external reviewer access is blocked until the capability is checked.

fields.Question: Can an external reviewer open it without creating an account?
fields.Treatment: A verified answer demonstrated on screen, if the capability exists.
fields.Held constant: Offer and destination; do not bundle this with the first experiment.
fields.Guardrail: Related support complaints; establish collection method.
fields.Review rule: No launch until product evidence and instrumentation exist.
fields.Inconclusive outcome: An unsupported product claim cannot be tested into truth.

cards.next: Obtain a product answer and artifact before allocating production effort.
